summary: Add exponential poll backoff and watch stop conditions for cheap PR babysitting (#1079).
migration_impact: No downstream action required. Existing --interval remains supported as a deprecated alias for --min-interval.
migration_guidance: 1. Use --min-interval and --max-interval to configure polling backoff.
2. Use --max-hours to stop a watch after a wall-clock duration.
agent_notes: The --watch loop uses exponential backoff, resetting when the babysit report changes, and stops on merge, close, or --max-hours. The watcher always removes its pidfile on exit.
